# CLAIMs with `works` `governance-of-becoming`

*Works — A manuscript the record's claims are marshalled into. Membership says a claim is in the work; whether the record believes it is the status, and the two disagree (ADR-032).*

**The Governance of Becoming** — the owner's article series, requested at U31 of the exchange "Memes, Contracts, and Systemic Normativity" and proposed by ChatGPT on 2026-11-24 (A49) as fourteen articles and reordered at U32 (A51, the order the owner took on 2026-11-25), with governance-of-possibility as its Article 2, to be collected as The Governance of Becoming: Individuation, Interdependence, and the Organization of Possibility; its precursor draft is the manuscript Becoming Through One Another (A26 to A28), requested at U20. Organizations individuate through maintained relationships that make their processes mutually consequential, store work, distribute authority and create dependencies, implicit contracts among them; cooperation changes its participants, so exploitation, domination and agency without answerability can arise from success; normative governance is the legitimate organization of those transformations, including the capacity to discover and correct them, and constitutional regeneration is its political form. Its argument is held mainly in the lines distributed-agency, dependence-and-domination, organizational-normativity and will-organization.

| [CLAIM-603](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-603.md) v8 | A capability lost because another reliably supplies it is the Black Queen's loss, favoured to the one who loses it, and whether it is dependency or division of labour is decided by the supply, not the loss: one-way supply set from outside, as aid is, leaves a dependence that nothing in the dependent's dynamics limits and that withdrawal punishes, while reciprocal loss, each partner supplying what the other gave up, leaves interdependence, so the aim framed as self-sufficiency is better framed as reciprocity | The assistant's, on the owner's remark of 2026-11-05 that "assured help makes recipients lose skill" sounds "closely related to niche differentiation and specialization phenomena". Buchnera ([THEORY-1103](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1103.md)) has lost the genes its host covers and kept those its host lacks. What differs is the supply. A Black Queen loss stops by itself when helpers grow rare, because the helpers are the same population. | [CLAIM-921](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-921.md) v5 | Where competence decays without funded maintenance and a capability is committed only when competent enough, a budget that follows observed use has a state in which the capability is never used or funded again whenever the base budget alone sustains competence below that level, any stretch without occasions long enough for competence to decay there reaches it whatever each use was paid, so at the same expected funding the chance of loss within a given time has a lower bound that rises as occasions grow rarer and does not depend on the payment per use, while maintenance funded apart from use, at a level that sustains the threshold, has no such state | Found in running [LEAD-036](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-036.md)'s study ([CASE-343](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-343.md)) of A's model from [QUESTION-386](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-386.md).
